boundary: Actual fixed-line-valued finite additive characters on the cyclotomic kernel are constructed. Inverse-character conjugation, open kernel, at-p decomposition-kernel vanishing and away inertia-kernel vanishing (conditional on resonant bad-place absorption) are proved. Nonsplitting produces a surjective order-p character; character vanishing is equivalent to splitting and gives a tower step. Global character vanishing, full tower, resonant bad-place absorption, actual Frobenius relation and Mazur/Eisenstein geometry remain open; general hno is unfinished.
